title: Attribution-first roadmap traceability index

assessment_terms.design_only: User goal or approved design direction; no directly equivalent runtime feature

evidence_scope: All IDs are grounded in QUESTIONS_AND_ANSWERS.md. A mapped adapter is related, never a proof of full coverage.
